about: What was tested for the Portable Raman controller, DataFed edition, and how. Everything ran on one Mac, in simulation, with the local demo catalog. Entries set to false in 'verified' were not tested at all.

not_verified.detail: No account, no login, no connection. The DataFed adapter is tested against the package's real reply classes, an autospec of its API class and an in-memory stand-in only; so is the holding back of simulated captures (datafed.include_simulated). The collection item limit and the allocation's record limit are not known.
No transfer of any kind. The local demo catalog imitates asynchronous uploads; Globus Connect Personal was not installed or used.
Not run on ARC, under Slurm, against DataFed or with Globus; the batch script's shell logic was tried with stand-in commands only. See data_layer/arc/README.md, 'Not verified'.
None attached during any step. Not run: hardware_check without --simulate, run_hardware.sh, the device self-tests, and the backend's two read-only identity calls on the real module.
The edition was built and run on macOS only; the Windows branch of laser_test/tests/CMakeLists.txt cannot configure from this folder.

run_simulated.sh and Qt Creator's Run were not used: the lines of main() that take both locks and name the preferences store did not run. The window code itself ran in the test programs and in a scratch driver.
